cohort: The study monitored 133 neonates born very preterm (<32 weeks gestation) or weighing less than 1,500 g at birth.
finding: Various prenatal, perinatal, and postnatal factors, including maternal origin, gestational age, medical complications, and Apgar scores, were associated with an increased or decreased likelihood of suspected ASD in very preterm and very low birth weight toddlers.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a lower incidence of suspected ASD.
